name: Hawaiian Pineapple Chicken & Veggies with Coconut Rice

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F). Line three large baking sheets with parchment paper.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 ½ lemons
3 green bell peppers
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ small bunches cilantro
1 ½ small pineapples

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince the garlic. Peel and mince (or grate) the ginger.
Juice the lemons into a large bowl.
Add garlic, ginger, soy sauce, ketchup, brown sugar, rice vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, black pepper, and cornstarch to the bowl with the lemon juice. Whisk until smooth and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp soy sauce
¾ cup ketchup
3 tbsp brown sugar
3 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
⅜ tsp black pepper
2 tbsp cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: Seed the bell peppers and cut into 1-inch pieces; place in the bowl with the sauce.
Peel and cut the onions into 1-inch pieces; add to the bowl with the bell peppers.
Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add the chicken into the large bowl with the sauce and veggies. Toss to combine and spread onto the baking sheets in a single layer; bake for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat a large saucepan over high heat. Add coconut milk, water, and salt and bring to a boil.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (398 ml) cans coconut milk
1 cup water
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Cut skin off pineapples, core, and cut into bite-sized pieces and set aside. You will need about 6 cups diced.
Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir in the rice, and reduce the heat to low. Cover and cook until the rice is tender and all liquid has been absorbed, about 12 minutes.
Remove chicken from oven and add the pineapple to the mixture. Return to oven and bake for another 10 minutes, until chicken is cooked through.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
To serve, divide the rice between bowls and top with the chicken and veggies. Garnish with cilantro and enjoy!
